recommended_substrate_queue_entry.implementation_hint: 634b PROVED the Stage-0b protected window + contact-gating (G0b retention 3/3; n_decay_only_updates=0). The next blocker is two coupled gaps. (a) Benefit-magnitude/threshold mismatch: contact-gating skips only benefit<=scaffold_p2_contact_benefit_threshold(1e-6), but GoalState.update (goal.py:209-224) seeds z_goal only when effective_benefit = benefit_exposure * z_goal_seeding_gain(1.0) * (1 + drive_weight(2.0)*drive_trace) > benefit_threshold(0.1). Natural wild benefit obs_body[11] ~0.03 => effective_benefit <= ~0.09 < 0.1, so wild contact never fires the pull and the band (1e-6, ~0.1-effective) DECAYS the consolidated trace instead of refreshing it. Candidate levers (one or a combination, pick via a small sweep): raise z_goal_seeding_gain above 1.0; lower benefit_threshold below 0.1; apply drive_floor~0.9 (the EXQ-582a first-PASS arm, effective_benefit >= benefit*2.8); and/or raise the scaffold contact_threshold to the seeding floor so sub-seeding whiffs are PROTECTED (skipped) rather than decaying the trace. (b) Still-open foraging-competence half (634): strengthen/lengthen P0/P1 so >=2/3 seeds reach self-sustaining consumption (only seed 43 survives P1). (c) Test-design: redefine the mature-test z_goal acceptance readout to read AT genuine consumption events (632-style num_contact_events) rather than the forced-feed-calibrated frozen-peak G3>0.4, which is anti-correlated with foraging. Keep ready=false; do not queue 603f until a consumption-event-gated re-validation clears.
